alerts.name: Integer Overflow Error
alerts.desc: An integer overflow condition exists when an integer used in a compiled program extends beyond the range limits and has not been properly checked from the input stream.
alerts.solution: Ensure that the application is compiled with built-in overflow checking.
alerts.otherinfo: Potential Integer Overflow. Status code changed on the input of a long string of ones.
